stem.text: Which statement describes $\beta^{-}$ decay in terms of a simple quark model?

A.text: A down quark changes to an up quark and emits an electron and an electron antineutrino.

B.text: A down quark changes to an up quark and emits a positron and an electron neutrino.

C.text: An up quark changes to a down quark and emits an electron and an electron antineutrino.

D.text: An up quark changes to a down quark and emits a positron and an electron neutrino.
